title: Nine Grok bots pitched as a full marketing stack including SEO and GEO
summary: Thread pitching nine specialized Grok bots for marketing—ads, SEO audits that ship fixes, GEO ranking pages, Meta creative generation, ad spy, CRO, Shopify edits, ChatGPT ads, and reporting—with a services upsell to set them up in 24 hours.
question_it_answers: What Grok-bot roles does Ira Bodnar propose for a full automated marketing stack?

claims.text: SEO Grok connects a site, audits it, and ships fixes without waiting on developers or freelancers.
claims.evidence:
1-click connect your site or store
->  Audits and ships the fixes itself
->  No more waiting on a developer and an SEO freelancer to get it done
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

claims.text: GEO Grok shows buyer-query rankings in ChatGPT and Gemini then writes pages to earn mentions.
claims.evidence:
"Show me how I rank by buyer query in ChatGPT and Gemini"
->  Then it writes the pages that get you mentioned
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

claims.text: Creative Grok is described as trained on 178K labeled Meta ads and shipping 30+ new creatives weekly.
claims.evidence:
Trained on 178K labeled Meta ads, tagged by hook, format and performance
->  Ships 30+ new creatives a week, because creative is the only alpha left
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

numbers.label: labeled Meta ads in training set
